facts.text: Grab something at the next stop, Max. Five stops tonight and I don't do them on an empty stomach.
facts.why: Not found among Vincent's lines on the quote page. It is printed in quote marks as his words, and the 'empty stomach' idea does not match how he talks to Max.

vibe.verdict: The cab timetable and Max's night read well, but the side photo is a dark blur and the food names are only lightly in the film.
